results.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
results.content: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

results.title: Lumbini cruise to eight-wicket win as Pokhara suffer third defeat
results.content: Lumbini chase down a target of 98 with 50 balls to spare to move to the top of the Nepal Premier League table with five points from three matches.

results.title: Nepal has two decades to turn its youth bulge into an economic dividend, World Bank reports
results.content: Weak job growth, remittance dependency, and poor social safety nets threaten Nepal’s chance to capitalise on its demographic dividend.

results.title: Lumbini bowlers restrict struggling Pokhara to 97 for nine
results.content: Ruben Trumpelmann takes three wickets as Pokhara suffer another batting collapse in their third match of the Nepal Premier League, leaving Lumbini a target of 98.

results.title: Madhav Nepal, Minendra Rijal among 97 accused in Rs735m land-swap case
results.content: The CIAA alleges that government officials colluded to let a company exchange valuable land in Biratnagar, which should have been confiscated, for cheaper plots.

results.title: How Deepak Bhatta became Nepal’s most influential power broker
results.content: For two decades, Bhatta cultivated extraordinary access to Nepal’s political and bureaucratic elite while keeping himself largely out of public view. A money-laundering investigation has now exposed the networks around him.

results.title: Indian national killed, New Zealander injured in mid-air chopper collision near Everest
results.content: In what is believed to be Nepal’s first mid-air helicopter collision, two choppers struck each other while attempting to land at Pheriche, raising fresh concerns over flight safety and the growing number of helicopter operations in the Everest region.

results.title: Kathmandu metropolis bans sale of plastic flowers and garlands ahead of Tihar
results.content: The move aims to protect local flower growers and ensure that sales are concentrated at designated locations across the capital.

results.title: Protect Nepalis in Saudi Arabia
results.content: Houthi drones have killed a Nepali worker. Diplomacy must protect the rest and bring the stranded home.

results.title: Nepal and India agree to step up cooperation on border security
results.content: The two security forces will share intelligence and coordinate efforts to curb smuggling, human trafficking, counterfeit currency and drug trafficking.

results.title: In ‘Bhag Bheda Bhag’, a flock of sheep holds up a mirror to Nepali society
results.content: Samyog Guragain’s absurdist play satirises the contradictions and herd mentality of contemporary Nepali society with a generous dose of humour.

results.title: Nepali film ‘Panch Pandav’ faces boycott calls over perceived religious insults
results.content: Filmmakers say social media campaigns based on trailers and short clips threaten creative freedom, while critics insist they have the right to question religious representations.

results.title: Nepal’s remittance boom is hiding a hiring bust
results.content: War and Gulf localisation policies are shrinking overseas hiring, and a migration-dependent economy has little to fall back on.

results.title: Kathmandu Gorkhas defeat Karnali Yaks, once again
results.content: Kathmandu have now beaten Karnali in all three NPL seasons, chasing down 181 with two balls to spare in their latest encounter.

results.title: Nepal Police transfers remain stalled amid political interference
results.content: Police chiefs in nine districts have served for over a year. Officers say morale and leadership development are suffering.

results.title: US overtakes India as Nepal’s largest tourism source market for first time
results.content: American arrivals surged 31 percent in October, while Indian visitors fell 30 percent as the August floods disrupted pilgrimage routes and dampened travel from Nepal’s traditionally biggest source market.

results.title: Indian foreign secretary to visit Nepal ahead of Balendra Shah’s proposed India trip
results.content: Vikram Misri’s November 4-5 visit is expected to help prepare the agenda for the Nepali prime minister’s visit later this month.

results.title: Rashid Khan and Karan KC power Kathmandu Gorkhas to first win
results.content: The Gorkhas chase down 181 with two balls to spare, handing Karnali Yaks their first defeat of the season.
